en.quote: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
en.riddle: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: אֲשֶׁר אָֽמְרוּ לִלְשֹׁנֵנוּ נַגְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵינוּ אִתָּנוּ מִי אָדוֹן לָֽנוּ
he.speaker: מִי אָדוֹן לָֽנוּ

en.quote: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
en.riddle: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: מִשֹּׁד עֲנִיִּים מֵאַנְקַת אֶבְיוֹנִים עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר יְהוָה אָשִׁית בְּיֵשַׁע יָפִיחַֽ לֽוֹ
he.riddle: מִשֹּׁד עֲנִיִּים מֵאַנְקַת אֶבְיוֹנִים עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר
he.speaker: יְהוָה
